# id: PG-gate-90-balance-farming
# covers: PG 161-176 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Wheat Farm L worked by Avarek (its own job); pg_operate output_progress per 30-game-minute window at speed 10
#   (JobOperateScaling on = the default build). Skills 10/25/75/90 without gear, then 3 x gear points at 50.
# verify: calls > 0 in every window; own50 ~ x1.5 of none at the same skill (pg-13 measured x1.50 on auto-home).
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Wheat Farm L" dist 6 radius 1000 ~ moved=1
building "Wheat Farm L" 1000
fill "Wheat Farm L" Water 40 radius 1000
job Avarek "Wheat Farm L" radius 1000
pg_jobscale on ~ jobOperateScaling=1
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 10 900
@until 300 pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" radius 100 near Avarek ~ calls=[1-9]
speed 0
# --- g1: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek farming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek farming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
fill "Wheat Farm L" Water 40 radius 1000 topup
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" reset radius 100 near Avarek ~ \(reset\)
stat Avarek farming
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek farming
@set OP pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" radius 100 near Avarek ~ output_progress=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,161,farming,25,0,none,g1,operate,T${T0}_${T1},0,${OP}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g2: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Avarek farming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" farming 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek farming ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
fill "Wheat Farm L" Water 40 radius 1000 topup
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" reset radius 100 near Avarek ~ \(reset\)
stat Avarek farming
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek farming
@set OP pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" radius 100 near Avarek ~ output_progress=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,161,farming,25,50,own50,g2,operate,T${T0}_${T1},0,${OP}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g3: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek farming 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek farming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
fill "Wheat Farm L" Water 40 radius 1000 topup
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" reset radius 100 near Avarek ~ \(reset\)
stat Avarek farming
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek farming
@set OP pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" radius 100 near Avarek ~ output_progress=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,161,farming,90,0,none,g3,operate,T${T0}_${T1},0,${OP}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g4: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek farming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek farming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
fill "Wheat Farm L" Water 40 radius 1000 topup
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
jobs Avarek ~ jobs=[1-9]
pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" reset radius 100 near Avarek ~ \(reset\)
stat Avarek farming
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Avarek farming
@set OP pg_operate "Wheat Farm L" radius 100 near Avarek ~ output_progress=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,161,farming,25,0,none,g4,operate,T${T0}_${T1},0,${OP}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
clearjobs Avarek
